texts.name: Ibaraki
texts.biography: Ibaraki is the oni who once haunted the ruined Rashomon gate, feared by every warrior of the old capital. When a famous swordsman cut off her arm, she returned in disguise, snatched it back and fled laughing into the mountains. Now she leads the oni of the Summit as a general, preferring a straight charge and a broken shield wall to any clever plan. Her troops follow her because she always strikes first and hardest.

specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill percentage.
